status: Design protocol; input audit implemented; association models not yet implemented or executed

cohort.habitat_curation: Accepted mangrove sediment cohort; do not reclassify
cohort.independence: Resolve study, biological site, BioSample and technical runs before inference; coordinate groups are provisional

measurement.relative_denominator: Sum of all KO assignments in each selected profile before cycle or prevalence filtering
measurement.allowed_label: Relative representation of recovered KO assignments

interpretation.bio1: Long-term climatic mean temperature; not sediment temperature at collection
interpretation.soc_mean: Modelled soil organic carbon; not measured labile or dissolved carbon
interpretation.phh2o_mean: Modelled soil pH; verify apparent x10 encoding

environment.missingness: Report per contrast; no blanket imputation of site-level covariates; any predictive imputation must be learned inside training folds

responses.directed_panel: Unique KOs in curated cycles; do not duplicate tests for KOs belonging to multiple cycles
responses.broad_exploration: All detected KOs subject to estimability filters
responses.reaction_scores: Keep member genes and alternatives separate; no automatic sum of required subunits as pathway abundance

association_model_candidate.environment_requirement: Reviewed DESCRIPTION requires R >= 4.4; use a separate pinned analysis environment
association_model_candidate.estimand: Within-study environmental association with observed detection or positive relative representation
association_model_candidate.site_and_biosample: Model dependence when estimable; otherwise validated aggregation and explicit estimand change

recovery_adjustment.detection: Evaluate log total KO assignments as imperfect recovery covariate
recovery_adjustment.positive_representation: Recovery diagnostic and sensitivity; do not mechanically adjust for its own denominator

association_model_candidate.support_warning: Admission floors are not sufficient validation; check effective units, within-study predictor contrasts and model rank per KO
association_model_candidate.multiple_testing: BH jointly across valid primary panel KO x priority predictor x outcome tests; separate declared exploratory family for remaining KOs
association_model_candidate.failure_policy: Retain descriptive record and explicit failure reason; do not silently switch to an easier significant model
association_model_candidate.validation_before_real_fits: Pin version and calibrate synthetic nulls, confounding, clustered observations and zero patterns

multivariate.composition: Prespecify common log-ratio reference and zero handling; Hellinger and presence-absence sensitivity
multivariate.space: Geodesic distances; constrained spatial basis or regional sensitivity
multivariate.permutations: Exchange whole independent units within study when valid; never permute only within a site to test a site-constant predictor
multivariate.realm: Not identifiable conditional on all study fixed effects in current design

prediction.preprocessing: All feature selection, transformations and tuning inside training folds
prediction.unseen_study_effect: Study fixed effects describe association only; predictive transfer needs a model that can predict an unseen study without its fitted coefficient

atlas.unlocated_profiles: Retain in tables and cycle views
atlas.cooccurrence_network: Optional exploratory supplement; no inference of cooperation, metabolite exchange or flux

update_contract: Repeat on the new matrix with explicit quantification units and versions; compare common samples separately from expanded sampling; reanalysis of shared samples is not independent validation
